errors.text: The cited evidence concerns Cr addition to HfMoTaTiZr, not HfNbTaTiZr, and therefore does not establish preservation of mechanical properties in the proposed alloy.
The cited study supports strength and ductility changes but provides no evidence that 4.2 at% Cr improves oxidation resistance.
The proposed solid-solution and Laves-phase mechanisms address mechanical strengthening, not the formation of a protective oxide scale or any other oxidation-resistance mechanism.
No oxidation kinetics, scale-composition criterion, or quantitative exposure duration is predicted, so the central claimed benefit is insufficiently testable.
